leak.oracleIsCeiling: mktOwnOracle / mktSosOracle / mktPlayoffOracle use closing lines from the whole season and are NOT a proposal. They are the ceiling: if the leaky version cannot beat the placebo family, no honest version can.
leak.honestCaveat: nflverse stores the CLOSING line, so even the week-1 line is set about two weeks after his draft. The honest arm is therefore optimistic, which is the safe direction for a null and the unsafe direction for a win.
leak.rosterTeam: Team comes from roster_{year}.csv, a season-level file. For a player traded in October it is the wrong team. Counted below, not assumed away.

variables.mktOwnHonest: Own implied team total, week 1 only (available before the draft)
variables.mktSosHonest: Mean over the full schedule of the opponent's week-1 implied points conceded
variables.mktPlayoffHonest: Same, weeks 15-17 only (the app shows this as Playoff D)
variables.mktOwnOracle: Own implied team total, all closing lines of the season (LEAKY - ceiling only)
variables.mktSosOracle: Mean over the schedule of the opponent's season-long implied points conceded (LEAKY)
variables.ecrVsAdp: adp - ecr. Positive: the experts are higher on him than the crowd
variables.ecrSd: Dispersion of the expert consensus about him

degreesOfFreedom.correctedTNote: board-lab.mjs's Bonferroni-like formula, reported for comparability only. It is NOT a condition here: with this many variants it demands |t| > 5 from an 11-season mean, which no real effect of this size could ever reach, so it would fail everything and therefore measure nothing. The placebo family replaces it with a measured family-wise threshold.
degreesOfFreedom.note: The reported walk-forward number spends none of these on hindsight: variable, weight and scope are chosen on prior seasons only. The negative half of the weight grid was added AFTER Tier A showed every volume variable correlating NEGATIVELY with the projection residual — that is a data-dependent widening of the search and it is counted in `variants` for exactly that reason.

placeboPooled.metric: antisymmetric component (E[w>0] - E[w<0]) / 2, pooled over all cells
placeboPooled.note: the null DISTRIBUTION of this measurement. A real variable must beat this, not zero.

coreHypothesis.question: Is the signal stronger in PPR than in standard? Receptions are opportunity that scores 1.0 in PPR and ~0 in standard, so a genuine reception-opportunity effect should be larger in PPR, with half between.
coreHypothesis.metric: antisymmetric component per format, paired per season

verdict: OPPORTUNITY EARNS A SMALL WEIGHT — mktOwnOracle, mktSosOracle. Pooled over all 270 cells (one test per variable, t from 11 seasons), mktOwnOracle: antisymmetric +51.2 points per unit of the weight grid (t=6.874, 11/11 seasons, 95% CI [37.7, 65.9], monotone in |w| 4/4, direction MORE is better); mktSosOracle: antisymmetric +29.1 points per unit of the weight grid (t=2.542, 10/11 seasons, 95% CI [8.6, 50.7], monotone in |w| 4/4, direction MORE is better). All four pre-set conditions hold: the pooled CI excludes zero and the pooled |t| beats the largest pooled |t| any of 8 placebo noise variables reaches through the identical grid; the pooled mean is outside the placebo prediction interval; the weight curve is monotone across the two-sided grid; and walk-forward selection beats placebo walk-forward. NOTHING IS WIRED INTO src/ ON THIS EVIDENCE — see README 5b on the variant that gained +109 and was still rejected because the search chose it, and 5h on age winning the raw search 4/4 and failing walk-forward 4/4.
